1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 8 m de altura, de corteza fina y lisa gris oscuro, ramas delgadas y espinosas, hojas pequeñas ovaladas y grandes flores de color blanco o amarillento; su madera, por arder con facilidad, se usa para antorchas y como leña para cocinar. Rubiaceae, Exostema caribaeum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 8 m, with dark grey smooth bark, slender and thorny branches, small oval-shaped leaves, and large white or yellowish flowers; its wood, due to its ease of ignition, is used for torches and as firewood for cooking. Rubiaceae, Exostema caribaeum.
